pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo antoraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ caranti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:1.4: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo antoraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ carissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:1.6: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo antoraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ carantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:1.9: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunīyo antoraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ carissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:1.11: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:1.12.1: yā pana bhikkhunī antoraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikā cārikaṃ careyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:2.1.8: tasmiṃ magge corānaṃ niviṭṭhokāso dissati bhuttokāso dissati ṭhitokāso dissati nisinnokāso dissati nipannokāso dissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:2.1.10: tasmiṃ magge corehi manussā hatā dissanti viluttā dissanti ākoṭitā dissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:2.1.14: kukkuṭasaṃpāte gāme gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc37:2.1.15: agāmake araññe aḍḍhayojane aḍḍhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
